name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea tests cluster-warhead cruise missiles; denies Binance theft
state: North Korea said it tested a strategic cruise missile with a new cluster-munition warhead in a weekend launch, KCNA reported on 2 Nov (Stars and Stripes), after an October run of ballistic, hypersonic and submarine-launched tests (Arms Control Association). Kim Yo Jong called the FBI's Binance theft finding 'absurd' on 3 Nov (ABC). No nuclear test or ICBM launch has been reported.
for_you: No change for the public. Follow FCDO advice for travel to South Korea and Japan.
rubric_hit: Cruise and ballistic missile launches = Watch; no nuclear test or ICBM
